## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù is the *Garbhāvakrāntir-nirdeśa* — the Mahāyāna sūtra on the embryological development of a being from conception (*garbhāvakrānti*, "entering the womb") to birth, organised as a week-by-week description of the foetus's development across 38 weeks. Later incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* as assembly 13 (*Pútísà chù tāi huì* 菩薩處胎會).

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's Cháng'ān period (266 – 313 CE). The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The doctrinal substance — the embryological cosmology — is one of the more unusual topics in the Mahāyāna canon, integrating Indian medical-anatomical knowledge with Buddhist soteriological teaching.

The Taishō text (T0317) is established on the standard apparatus.
